description: 弃后引车阻塞黑王，双变化均将死
explanation_en: Qf8+ creates a two-way mating trap. If Black's rook captures the queen, it blocks h8 and allows Ne7#; if the king captures, White has a rook mate on h8.

intro.popup: 💡 弃后阻塞：黑王在g8，白后到哪里能引出一步精妙的阻塞将杀？注意这里有两条不同的将杀路线！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Blockade by queen sacrifice: Black's king is on g8. Where can White move the queen to set up a clever blockade mate? There are two mating lines.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qf8+是关键！黑车吃后阻塞h8，白马Ne7将死；若黑王吃后，白车Rh8将死——双变化！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qf8+ is the key. If the rook captures, it blocks h8 and Ne7# follows; if the king captures, Rh8# mates. Both replies lose.

moves.popup: 白后将军！黑王只有两种应法，每种都是死路。
moves.popup_en: White checks with Qf8. Black has only two responses, and both lead to mate.

moves.popup: 黑车吃后——阻塞了h8出路！白马立即Ne7将死。
moves.popup_en: The rook captures the queen and blocks the king's escape on h8, allowing Ne7#.

moves.popup: 马将死！黑王被己方车封住h8，f8，白马Ne7封f8和h8，绝无逃路！
moves.popup_en: Ne7# is checkmate! Black's rook blocks h8 and White's knight controls f8 and h8, leaving no escape.
